verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the IRS account-creation page stating that "all selfie, video, and biometric data are automatically deleted for users who verify for the IRS." That is a fixed retention/deletion policy for one narrow data class, not a control the user can exercise, so it barely counts toward the story. Missing for 10: user-facing controls to set retention periods or request deletion of tax/account data, documentation of retention schedules for filed returns, transcripts, and account data, and any export-then-delete or data-subject-request workflow, plus independent corroboration.
